title: Above-Filter Digestion Proteomics reveals drug targets and localizes ligand binding site
authors: Bohdana Sokolova; Hassan Gharibi; Maryam Jafari; Hezheng Lyu; Silvia Lovera; Massimiliano Gaetani; Amir Ata Saei; Roman Zubarev
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于胰蛋白酶消化速率监测的化学蛋白质组学方法AFDIP，结合MD模拟定位药物结合位点，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和MD方法，但对象为药物-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: While a number of efficient chemical proteomics methods are available for determining protein targets of pharmaceutical drugs, each approach exhibits its own 'blind spot' and development of complementary techniques is needed. Here, we introduce the Above-Filter Digestion Proteomics (AFDIP) approach based on the monitoring of the rate of trypsin digestion. Digestion rate is decreased at the site of ligand binding to its target protein, while other sites may simultaneously experience an increase the digestion rate. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed that this increase may be due to allosteric structural changes related to backbone flexibility. We showcase the utility of AFDIP for deconvoluting the targets of versatile drugs and metabolites. Like other techniques, AFDIP allows for a two-dimensional analysis, with the second dimension based on drug concentration. AFDIP exhibits structural resolution, identifying drug target binding sites within 10 A, and for larger proteins often within 5 A of the crystallography-determined binding sites. Compared to earlier introduced limited proteolysis approaches, AFDIP provides easier sample preparation, deeper proteome analysis and broader sequence coverage. AFDIP is expected to find its place among the most efficient chemical proteomics methods currently available.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有多种高效的化学蛋白质组学方法可用于确定药物的蛋白质靶点，但每种方法都有其自身的“盲区”，因此需要开发互补技术。在此，我们介绍一种基于监测胰蛋白酶消化速率的“滤膜上消化蛋白质组学 (Above-Filter Digestion Proteomics, AFDIP)”方法。配体与其靶蛋白结合位点的消化速率降低，而其他位点可能同时经历消化速率增加。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟揭示，这种增加可能归因于与骨架灵活性相关的变构结构变化。我们展示了AFDIP在解析多种药物和代谢物靶点方面的实用性。与其他技术类似，AFDIP支持二维分析，第二维度基于药物浓度。AFDIP具有结构分辨率，能够识别药物靶点结合位点，误差在10 Å以内，对于较大蛋白质，通常与晶体学确定的结合位点相差在5 Å以内。与早期引入的有限蛋白水解方法相比，AFDIP提供了更简便的样品制备、更深入的蛋白质组分析和更广泛的序列覆盖。预计AFDIP将在当前可用的高效化学蛋白质组学方法中占有一席之地。
